compatibility.linuxQt: v1 SDK writer + separate TS H264/AAC + fMP4 H264/AAC + WebM VP9/Opus
compatibility.windowsQt: v1 SDK writer + separate TS H264/AAC + fMP4 H264/AAC + WebM VP9/Opus

initialCorrections: The test catalog producer originally selected video/audio views independently by presentation time, which can produce different segment counts for a shared physical file. It now publishes both descriptors atomically when the common resource is ready.
A fault-injection fixture initially wrote a zero over an already-zero PES prefix byte; it now changes that byte to X and proves constructor/update failure without exposing the other view.
limitations: Two required logical AVC/AAC views over the same init and complete shared TS media resources; no growing single file, muxed fMP4/WebM, arbitrary HLS/DASH, VFR/interlace/POC1, rollover/configuration change/live.
Strict framing is not full entropy validation; actual decoder remains authoritative.
No multi-hour/sync/physical output/source-site acceptance or maximum-index stress; bounds are admission limits.
Synchronous worker preparation copies growing immutable metadata/index; very large completed-catalog startup requires further cost assessment.
These are source/client SDK additions; Windows installed applications and their INIs were not replaced.
